auth.title: Caregiver Access
auth.hint: Enter the PIN to access system settings.
auth.pinError: Incorrect PIN. Please check with the responsible caregiver.

voice.title: Custom Voice Cloning
voice.description: Upload an audio file (.wav) of the patient to create a personalized synthesized voice.
voice.lgpd: GDPR/LGPD: Voice is sensitive biometric data. The model will be stored exclusively for local assistive use by the patient.

intro.title: Communication and independence through gaze
intro.tagline: IrisFlow turns eye movement into speech, writing and computer control — no touch, no voice, no head movement.
intro.patientBody: Navigates and communicates by looking at the screen. Nothing needs to be typed or pressed.
intro.caregiverBody: Sets up the app, follows usage and receives alerts. This first part is yours.

login.title: Sign in to your account
login.subtitle: Use the same email and password as on the website.
login.createAccount: No account yet? Create one on the website

errors.no-subscription: This account has no active subscription.
errors.device-limit: Your subscription is already active on another computer.
errors.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.

activated.title: You're all set
activated.boundHere: This computer has been linked to your account.

transfer.title: Move activation to this computer
transfer.explain: Your plan allows {{limit}} computer at a time. Activating here will disconnect the device below.

blocked.title: We couldn't validate your licence
blocked.revoked: Your subscription is no longer active.
blocked.device-unbound: This licence is linked to another computer.
blocked.grace-expired: The app has been offline for too long. Connect once to keep using it.

consent.title: Privacy
consent.lead: Before you add the patient, here is what happens to the data.
consent.localBody: Camera images, gaze calibration and patient details never leave this machine. No video is uploaded.
consent.remoteBody: Only your sign-in: email, password and the check that your subscription is active.
consent.checkbox: I have read and agree to the data handling described above.
